payload.title: Waypoint telemetry gap during Carn Eige ascent
payload.description: Device lost GPS lock for 14 minutes between waypoints 23 and 24 while transitioning above the treeline.

payload.title: Elevation drift exceeds 15m in canopy sections
payload.description: Barometric altimeter and GPS elevation disagree by up to 18m under dense canopy on the descent transition.
Device lost GPS lock for 14 minutes between waypoints 23 and 24. Field workaround: switched antenna profile to high-gain; monitoring next ascent transition.
